🩺 The latest NHS figures: 7.33 million cases on the waiting list — around 6.21 million people.

⏳ Roughly 111,000 have been waiting over a year. Last month it was 106,000. It went UP.

📉 Median wait is now 12 weeks. Before the pandemic it was 7.3 weeks. And in August only 75% of A&E patients were seen within four hours — before winter has even started.

💚 The staff aren't the problem. They're the only reason it isn't worse. The problem is a system that answers every bad number with a new target instead of a new plan.
